description:
Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq/channels/delivery_confirmation.ex and existing normalized outcome/observation producers; coordinate Engine persistence in zaq-9j8.6. Keep DeliveryConfirmation name and existing :record_delivery_confirmation / :record_delivery_observation events via NodeRouter. Forward confirmed provider messages with their canonical body/thread and confirmed attachment evidence. Aggregate failed/unconfirmed parts for one persisted-answer message association; do not create failed transcript rows or emit a provider failure notice. Successful provider messages retain normal transcript behavior.
Preserve uploaded-only versus delivered distinction, actual provider locators, edit identity and safe bounded errors. Source materialization handles never become provider locators. Reporting payloads contain no bytes, private plan, credentials or raw provider error. Existing persisted answer/connector scope comes from trusted outgoing metadata. Never downgrade transport success or resend because Engine is unavailable; partial successes remain successful facts.
Tests before implementation: multiple confirmed receipts with one grouped failure observation, only confirmed attachments, content-free copies, canonical versus formatted body, edit without duplicate history, uncertain versus rejected outcomes, missing persisted answer, spoofed scope cannot be supplied by report extras, Engine failure/exit isolated, callback cardinality and no send repeats. Integrate real Engine path after zaq-9j8.6; immediate Channel boundary tests may assert exact dispatched safe events.
Branches: full/partial/no confirmations, legacy single receipt, no files, invalid evidence, recording unavailable. Reuse existing DeliveryConfirmation tests.
Mocking: external transport/failure injection; Engine/NodeRouter real for integrated tests. No parallel persistence path.
Documentation: reporter contracts and Channels/Engine owning guides.
Action reuse: extend existing DeliveryConfirmation and Engine events; Engine remains history/persistence owner. No new Action/reporter lifecycle. This supersedes blanket reference per-part failure transcript projection; only failures group inside the existing details modal. Exact approved behavior is in zaq-9j8.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

comments.text: Moved to PR5 per Jad seven-PR split. Not part of feat/delivery_plan PR4. Existing functional/test/reuse specification retained. Executor prerequisite and PR5 review/coverage finalization must be planned before implementation.

Boundary audit/reuse: extend DeliveryConfirmation, keep existing Engine event names/NodeRouter; executor Result stays private. Add one attempt reporter: confirmed parts use safe receipt allowlist, original canonical answer for first successful root and actual continuation body/thread for subsequent parts; attachment display facts only for confirmed indices, provider file locator comes only from confirmed upload references, never source handles. Grouped failures use Result.safe_evidence once plus trusted outgoing persisted input/answer/connector IDs. Separate event failures are isolated and never alter transport result. Engine persistence/projection remains dependent zaq-9j8.6; no Channels writes or failed transcript parts.

Attempt reporting implemented through existing event names and DeliveryConfirmation. Confirmed parts carry canonical original body or actual continuation/thread, private Results retain publication context but safe_evidence excludes it, and attachment descriptors drop source identity/handles/attributes/bytes. Provider locator IDs derive only from confirmed upload inputs; direct SMTP files have no invented provider locator. One grouped failure event attaches only trusted persisted-answer/input/origin IDs. Malformed evidence emits nothing; missing persisted answer emits no grouped observation. Each reporting error/exit/throw is isolated from transport and later reports. Focused validation 126 passed including 10 properties and mix q passed; adding final thrown-report regression before closing. Engine persistence/projection follows zaq-9j8.6.
